$comment: Promotion order and registered integration branches (Decision [2026-09-11-0001]). Rules are written in terms of position in `trunks`, never in terms of branch names, so introducing a staging or release line is a one-line edit here and requires no rewording of CONTRIBUTING.md or docs/REQUIREMENTS.md. scripts/branch-model.js is the reader; .github/workflows/require-valid-pr-target.yml is the gate; scripts/audit-repo.js checks this file against the real CI filters.
